WITH e AS (SELECT timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:03:36.815119+00' t),
att AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders, e WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND created_at>=e.t),
fl AS (SELECT f.market_ticker, sum(f.quantity) q, sum(f.price*f.quantity)/NULLIF(sum(f.quantity),0) entry
       FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id, e
       WHERE o.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND o.action='buy' AND o.created_at>=e.t GROUP BY 1),
snap AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, COALESCE(quantity_fp,quantity::numeric) qty, realized_pnl, market_exposure
         FROM positions WHERE market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM att) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC),
tick AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, no_bid, captured_at
         FROM mmsell_position_ticks WHERE market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM att) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC),
open AS (SELECT s.market_ticker, s.qty, fl.entry, t.no_bid, t.captured_at,
                (t.no_bid - fl.entry) * s.qty / 100.0 AS unreal
         FROM snap s JOIN fl ON fl.market_ticker=s.market_ticker LEFT JOIN tick t ON t.market_ticker=s.market_ticker
         WHERE abs(s.qty) > 0.01)
SELECT 'A_realized' k, to_char(COALESCE(sum(realized_pnl),0),'FM990.0000')||'  settled='||count(*)::text v
  FROM snap WHERE qty=0 AND realized_pnl IS NOT NULL AND market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl)
UNION ALL SELECT 'B_unrealized_total', to_char(COALESCE(sum(unreal),0),'FM990.0000')||'  open='||count(*)::text||'  marked='||sum(CASE WHEN no_bid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::text FROM open
UNION ALL SELECT 'C_TOTAL_live', to_char((SELECT COALESCE(sum(realized_pnl),0) FROM snap WHERE qty=0 AND realized_pnl IS NOT NULL AND market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl)) + (SELECT COALESCE(sum(unreal),0) FROM open),'FM990.0000')
UNION ALL SELECT 'D_open_'||lpad(row_number() over (order by unreal)::text,2,'0'), rpad(market_ticker,42)||' entry='||to_char(entry,'FM990')||' nobid='||COALESCE(no_bid::text,'?')||' unreal='||to_char(unreal,'FM990.00') FROM open ORDER BY 1
